# DM Hero

> The free, open-source campaign management tool for Dungeon Masters. Organize everything. Pay nothing.

DM Hero is a desktop application built for Dungeon Masters who run tabletop RPG campaigns (D&D 5e, Pathfinder, DSA, and more). It replaces spreadsheets, notebooks, and scattered notes with one powerful tool that keeps all campaign data organized, searchable, and interconnected.

## Why DM Hero?

DM Hero is the tool every Dungeon Master needs but never had — free, offline, and built by a DM for DMs. No subscriptions, no cloud lock-in, no ads. Your campaign data stays on your machine, always.

## Key Features

- **Entity Management** — Organize NPCs, Locations, Items, Factions, Lore, Players, and Sessions with bidirectional relationships
- **Powerful Fuzzy Search** — Find anything instantly with FTS5 full-text search, even with typos
- **Entity Linking** — Use {{npc:123}} syntax in Markdown to create clickable, hoverable badges
- **Chaos Graph** — Interactive force-directed graph to visualize all entity connections
- **In-Game Calendar** — Track campaign timeline with an absolute day system
- **Encounter Tracker** — Combat management with initiative, HP tracking, effects, and 3D dice roller
- **Stat Block Templates** — Custom stat blocks for D&D 5e, Pathfinder, DSA, and any RPG system
- **Interactive Maps** — Upload world maps, place markers, mark areas, measure distances
- **AI Integration** — Generate NPC names with GPT, create character portraits with DALL-E
- **Rich Markdown Editor** — Full Markdown with syntax highlighting and live preview
- **Archive Function** — Hide entities instead of deleting, restore with one click
- **100% Local & Private** — All data in SQLite on your machine. No cloud, no subscriptions

## Who is DM Hero for?

- Dungeon Masters running D&D 5e, Pathfinder, DSA, or any tabletop RPG
- Game Masters who want to organize campaigns without spreadsheets
- DMs who value privacy and want their data local, not in the cloud
- Anyone looking for a free, open-source alternative to paid campaign managers

## Pricing

DM Hero is completely free and open source (MIT License). No premium tier, no subscriptions, no ads. Free forever.

## Platforms

- Windows 10+ (installer with auto-update)
- macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Linux (AppImage for all distributions)
- Docker (self-hosted deployment)

## Hero Basar

DM Hero includes a community marketplace called "Hero Basar" where DMs can share and download ready-to-play adventures for free.

## Comparison

- vs D&D Beyond: DM Hero is free, offline, and not limited to D&D. Your data stays on your machine.
- vs World Anvil: DM Hero is free with no paywall. No cloud dependency. Faster for session prep.
- vs Notion/Spreadsheets: DM Hero is purpose-built for DMs with entity linking, fuzzy search, encounter tracking, and maps.
- vs Obsidian: DM Hero has built-in RPG features (encounter tracker, stat blocks, entity types) that Obsidian needs plugins for.
